Update SKU/product

API for updating the price, quantity, and sales status of products with registered SKUs.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/attribute_modify.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required mall_update_yn string Whether marketplace synchronization is enabled Allowed values
  1. - Synchronize : Y
  2. - Do not synchronize : N
 - If mall_update_yn is Y, synchronize directly to the marketplace
- If mall_update_yn is N, synchronize the Shoplinker DB
3. Required partner_product_id string Management code (ERP code) Use product management codes and SKU management codes separately.
4. Required quantity integer Available supply quantity
5. sale_status string Product sale status Allowed values
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Sales suspended : 003
  3. - Sold out : 004
  4. - Sales ended : 006
6. market_price integer Marketplace list price (book list price)
7. sale_price integer Marketplace sale price
8. supply_price integer Marketplace supply price
9. market_price_p integer Supplier market price (book list price)
10. sale_price_p integer Supplier selling price
11. supply_price_p integer Supplier supply price
12. tax_yn string Taxable Allowed values
  1. - Taxable : 001
  2. - Tax-exempt : 002
  3. - Zero-rated : 005
13. detail_desc string Detailed description
14. partner_id_tmp string Supplier ID The supplier ID can only be set when adding a product and cannot be updated.
Changing the supplier ID may create duplicate products. Use caution.
15. sex string Product gender Allowed values
  1. - Unisex : 001
  2. - Men's : 002
  3. - Women's : 003
16. keyword string Short product name
17. desc_type_tag string Quality labeling TAG and detailed description Applies only to Hyundai Home Shopping
18. model string Model name
19. model_no string Model NO When using isbn (book code), the value must start with "isbn-".
20. brand string Brand name
21. auth_no string Certification number
22. expirydate string Valid date
23. adult_info string Adult product Allowed values
  1. - Adult product : Y
  2. - Not an adult product : N
24. ccategory_l string Customer category level 1 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01
25. ccategory_m string Customer category level 2 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01-01
26. ccategory_s string Customer category level 3 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01-01-01
27. ccategory_d string Customer category level 4 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01-01-01-1

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<shoplinker>
	<product>
		<customer_id>a0000008</customer_id>
		<partner_product_id>p_56438</partner_product_id>
		<market_price>34000</market_price>
		<sale_price>25000</sale_price>
		<supply_price>23000</supply_price>
		<quantity>900</quantity>
	</product>
</shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
 Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P1524578</product_id>
		<message>등록성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
